result.evidence: The primary models 7700 12V and 7713 12V are both magnetic latching remote battery switches from Blue Sea Systems, matching the ML-RBS product line. The 2145 and 2155 are related remote control switches referenced in specifications, and 9160 is a related paralleling bus product. Clustering was applied only to the primary battery switches as they share the same product line and function.
